nodes.label: Architecture Principles
nodes.rationale: DRY, encapsulation via accessor methods, remove dead code and hardcoded values, list accumulation for strings, no type ignores, top-level imports, complete migrations in the same change.

nodes.label: Semver Versioning Policy
nodes.rationale: Every main commit changing a production file must bump pyproject.toml (PATCH for fixes/refactors, MINOR for features, MAJOR for breaking), then run uv lock and commit together.

nodes.label: CI Policy
nodes.rationale: Run scripts/ci.sh before pushing on macOS/Linux; Windows checks run natively via GitHub Actions windows-ci.yml (uv run pytest -m 'not live'); there is no scripts/ci.ps1.
